Here's how it works

Our Happy V® Prebiotic + Probiotic designed to support vaginal health and balance. Eliminate the odor, itch, gut bloating, and other symptoms.

1

We start by eliminating bad bacteria

Happy V's staple Prebiotic, PreforPro®, works in the most unique way. Known as a Bacteriophagic Prebiotic - it works by destroying the bad bacteria from the inside out. This gives good bacteria the advantage over bad bacteria in their constant battle for Prebiotics nutrients.*

2

Then we reintroduce beneficial bacteria

With the bad bacteria out of the way, the vaginal microbiome is in the perfect condition to reintroduce and accept good bacteria. Happy V's Probiotic + Prebiotic provides a broad spectrum of Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium to begin repopulation.

3

Our Micro friends get to work

As the Probiotics repopulate the vaginal ecosystem, they have access to more glucose-rich Prebiotics found in the Epithelial Cells, essentially in the lining of the vagina. These nutrients allow the Probiotics to produce their natural defenses - Lactic Acid and Hydrogen Peroxide.*

4

Our Natural Defenses change pH

These natural defenses, Lactic Acid and Hydrogen Peroxide, will begin making the vaginal flora more acidic. This creates the most optimal pH for good bacteria to thrive in and inhibits the growth of unwanted pathogens.*

5

The vaginal flora flourish

You've achieved optimal pH balance and vaginal flora health. However, it's important to remember that risks for reoccurrence can happen daily. This could be due to how we eat, the air we breathe, how we wipe and even our sexual health habits. That's why it is important to stay consistent in order to maintain your vaginal health.*

Scientifically proven ingredients to get you results

Biotin

  • Fortifies vaginal mucosa*
  • Boosts skin, hair & nails*
  • Supports energy metabolism*
Biotin (Vitamin B7) plays a key role in maintaining healthy mucous membranes, including vaginal tissue. It also supports keratin production for stronger hair, skin, and nails.

Bifidobacterium lactis

  • Supports digestion & regularity*
  • Enhances immune*
Bifidobacterium lactis is a well-researched probiotic strain that supports digestive regularity and helps strengthen the body's natural immune defenses.

Lactobacillus
rhamnosus

  • Maintains vaginal balance*
  • Supports vaginal immunity*
  • Supports vaginal comfort*
Lactobacillus rhamnosus is one of the most studied probiotic strains for vaginal health. It helps maintain a balanced vaginal microbiome and supports the body's natural defenses against infections.

Lactobacillus
crispatus

  • Dominates healthy vaginal flora*
  • Helps prevent pathogenic overgrowth*
Lactobacillus crispatus is arguably the most important probiotic species to vaginal health. It's found in the highest abundance in healthy women and helps to maintain vaginal pH levels and combat bad bacteria.

Lactobacillus
gasseri

  • Helps regulate vaginal pH*
  • Reduces odor and discharge*
  • Supports vagina microbial balance*
Lactobacillus gasseri helps maintain an optimal vaginal pH, reducing odor and discharge while supporting microbial balance in the vaginal and urinary tracts.

Bacillus subtilis

  • Survives stomach acid to support gut flora*
  • Aids nutrient absorption*
  • Supports immune and skin health*
Bacillus subtilis is a spore-forming probiotic that survives stomach acid to reach the gut intact. It supports nutrient absorption and helps maintain a healthy immune system and skin.
